_comment: NSE + BSE union, ONE row per company (no NSE/BSE duplicates). `exchange` is the primary listing, `alsoOn` the others. `hasFno` marks names with a derivatives contract: those support EQ, FUT and OPT in the trade form; the rest are cash-only (lotSize 1, quantity = SHARES). `lotSize` is the F&O contract multiplier and is 1 for cash-only names.
_lotSizeWarning: F&O and index lot sizes are revised by NSE/BSE several times a year. These reflect the post-November-2024 revision and MUST be re-verified against the current exchange circular before launch. They are admin-editable (Admin -> Instruments) and can be overridden per trade, so a stale value here never silently corrupts a user's P&L.
